title: The switch that sticks
desc: CDK5 is a messenger in nerve cells that only works with a partner. Among 16,376 human proteins, meet its partners, listen in on three of its healthy conversations, see the cut that leaves it stuck on, as in Alzheimer's disease, and the landscape of diseases it points to; with real protein structures at the centre.
page: The switch that sticks: CDK5, its network and brain diseases
sub: CDK5, its network and brain diseases
aria: Interactive 3D story of the kinase CDK5 among the human interactome: its activators, its partners, three healthy pathways, how calpain cuts p35 and leaves CDK5 stuck on, its pathway in Alzheimer's disease and the diseases its network points to, with protein structures
authors: Christiane Hütter (the Menche lab's CDK5_data); structures from the Protein Data Bank; the app's authors
